description: Cross-rule interaction tests: simultaneous multi-rule violations and edge-case interactions across CertProfileCommon, CertProfileNat and CertProfileLeg agents (R01/R06/R07/R08, R27/R28/R29, R32/R33, R36/R37/R39, R02/R22, R41)

elements._note_calc: CONFORME. R01: local scheme 'XX:FR-' matches ^[A-Z]{2}:[A-Z]{2}-\S+$ → OUI. R06: local scheme triggers check; name_reg_authority present → OUI. R16/R17/R18/R19: v3/AKI/no-forbidden/AIA → all OUI. Agent2 R09: CN+country+givenName → OUI. R10: nonRepudiation=comboA → OUI. R11: CRL present → OUI. R14: cert_policies present → OUI.

CONFORME. R27: qcstatements_critical absent → '' ne 'Y' → OUI. R28: has_qcs_compliance=Y → OUI. R29: has_qcs_cclegislation absent → OUI. All three QCS rules satisfied simultaneously. Agent2 R15: is_qualified=Y + has_qcstatements=Y → OUI.

CONFORME. R32: 0.4.0.194112.1.2 (QCP-n-qscd) in valid_oids → OUI. R33: is_qscd_policy=1 (OID 1.2) and has_qscd_stmt=1 (Y) → 1==1 → OUI. Bi-directional QSCD check satisfied. R27/R28/R29: not critical/compliance/no-ccleg → all OUI.

CONFORME. R02: local scheme 'FR:BE-' matches ^[A-Z]{2}:[A-Z]{2}-\S+$ → OUI. R07: local scheme triggers NRA check; name_reg_authority present → OUI. R16/R17/R18/R19: all OUI. Agent3 R22: orgName+orgId+CN+country → OUI. R23: nonRepudiation=comboA → OUI.

CONFORME. R26: is_qualified=Y + has_qcstatements=Y → OUI. R27: not critical → OUI. R28: compliance=Y → OUI. R29: no ccleg → OUI. R32: QEVCP-w (0.4.0.194112.1.4) in valid_oids → OUI. R39-qcs-type: web+qualified+has_qcs_type=Y → OUI. R41: cert_policy_oid=QEVCP-w → OUI. All WEB EU QC rules satisfied simultaneously.

NON_CONFORME. R01: local scheme 'XX:FR-' → format valid → OUI. R06: local scheme detected (contains ':') + name_reg_authority absent → NON. Interaction: R01 passes but R06 fails → cert_profile_result=KO. Agent2 verdict: nat_profile_result=OK (R09/R10/R11/R14 all pass).

NON_CONFORME. R01: 'BADFORMAT-XYZ' matches neither PAS|IDC|PNO|TAX|TIN|EID pattern nor local scheme (no ':') → NON → serial_number_format_ok=NON. R09 (agent2): no given_name/surname/pseudonym → identity identity check fails → nat_subject_ok=NON. Cross-agent dual failure: cert_profile_result=KO (R01) AND nat_profile_result=KO (R09).

NON_CONFORME. R27: qcstatements_critical=Y → NON (SHALL NOT be critical). R28: has_qcs_compliance absent → NON (Mandatory per Table 2). R29: has_qcs_cclegislation=Y → NON (Forbidden per Table 2). Triple simultaneous QCS violation → cert_profile_result=KO.

NON_CONFORME. R27: qcstatements_critical absent → OUI. R28: has_qcs_compliance absent → NON (Mandatory). R29: has_qcs_cclegislation=Y → NON (Forbidden). R27 passes but R28+R29 fail simultaneously → cert_profile_result=KO.

NON_CONFORME. R32: 0.4.0.194112.1.2 (QCP-n-qscd) valid OID → OUI. R33: is_qscd_policy=1 but has_qscd_stmt=0 ('N' ne 'Y') → 1≠0 → NON. Interaction: policy mandates QSCD statement but it is absent → QSCD statement mismatch (missing direction).

NON_CONFORME. R32: 0.4.0.194112.1.0 (QCP-n, non-QSCD policy) valid → OUI. R33: is_qscd_policy=0 but has_qscd_stmt=1 (Y) → 0≠1 → NON. Interaction: non-QSCD policy has unexpected QSCD statement (reverse direction conflict).

NON_CONFORME. R36: '1.2.840.113549.1.1.5' (sha1WithRSA) not in approved pk algo set → NON. R37: '1.2.840.10045.4.3.4' (ecdsa-with-SHA384) approved → OUI. Interaction: pk algo rejected while sig suite acceptable → pk_algorithm_ok=NON → cert_profile_result=KO.

NON_CONFORME. R36: '1.2.840.113549.1.1.5' not in approved pk algo list → NON. R37: same OID not in approved sig suite list → NON. Double algorithm failure: both pk and signature OIDs unapproved simultaneously.

NON_CONFORME. R36: RSA OID '1.2.840.113549.1.1.1' in approved set → OUI. R37: sha256WithRSAEncryption approved → OUI. R39: RSA requires ≥2048 bits; pk_key_size=1024 < 2048 → NON. Interaction: algorithm OIDs both approved but key size below minimum → pk_key_size_ok=NON → cert_profile_result=KO.

NON_CONFORME. R36: RSA approved → OUI. R37: '1.2.840.113549.1.1.5' (sha1WithRSAEncryption) not in approved sig suite list → NON. R39: RSA + 2048 ≥ 2048 → OUI. Interaction: key size boundary-compliant but signature suite unapproved → sig_suite_ok=NON → cert_profile_result=KO.

NON_CONFORME. R02: local scheme 'FR:BE-' matches ^[A-Z]{2}:[A-Z]{2}-\S+$ → OUI. R07: local scheme detected + name_reg_authority absent → NON. Interaction: R02 format valid but R07 NRA check fails → cert_profile_result=KO. Agent3 R22/R23: all OK (leg_profile_result=OK).

NON_CONFORME. R02: 'NTRDE-HRB12345.' matches NTR[A-Z]{2}-\S+ → OUI. R08: NTR + contains '.' → fires; id_part='HRB12345.' → trailing dot: 'HRB12345.' does not match ^\S+\.\S+$ (no BRN after dot) → NON. Interaction: R02 format valid but R08 EUID sub-structure invalid (BRI present, BRN absent).

NON_CONFORME. R02: 'BADID-NOFMT-123' matches neither VAT|NTR|...[A-Z]{2}-\S+ nor local scheme → org_id_format_ok=NON. R22 (agent3): has_org_name absent → leg_subject_ok=NON. Cross-agent dual failure: cert_profile_result=KO (R02) AND leg_profile_result=KO (R22).

NON_CONFORME. R02: local scheme 'BE:NL-' → OUI. R07: local scheme + name_reg_authority absent → NON. R22 (agent3): has_org_name absent → leg_subject_ok=NON. Dual cross-agent failure: R07 (common agent) + R22 (leg agent) simultaneously.

NON_CONFORME. R26: qcstatements=Y + is_qualified=Y → OUI. R27: qcstatements_critical=Y → NON. R28: has_qcs_compliance absent → NON. R29: no ccleg → OUI. R32: QEVCP-w valid → OUI. R41: QEVCP-w → OUI. R39-qcs-type: OUI. Double: R27+R28 NON → cert_profile_result=KO.

NON_CONFORME. R26/R27/R28/R29: all OK. R32: QCP-n OID (0.4.0.194112.1.0) in valid_oids → OUI. R39-qcs-type: web+qualified+has_qcs_type=Y → OUI. R41: cert_policy_oid=0.4.0.194112.1.0 ≠ QEVCP-w (0.4.0.194112.1.4) → NON. Interaction: R32 passes (valid QC OID) but R41 rejects (wrong OID class for WEB EU QC).

NON_CONFORME. R32: 0.4.0.194112.1.2 (QCP-n-qscd) valid → OUI. R33: is_qscd_policy=1 but has_qcs_qscd='N' → has_qscd_stmt=0 → 1≠0 → NON. R41: cert_policy_oid=0.4.0.194112.1.2 ≠ QEVCP-w → NON. Double failure: QSCD statement missing for QSCD policy + OID incompatible with WEB profile.
